name: Ford Sierra XR4
description:
The Ford Sierra XR4 is the Argentine-market variant of Ford's revolutionary aerodynamic family car. Manufactured locally by Ford Argentina from 1984 to 1991, the XR4 featured a 2.3L inline-four engine producing 120 hp and 18 kgm of torque.

Unlike its European turbocharged siblings, the XR4 relied on naturally aspirated power, delivering smooth and linear performance well-suited to Argentine roads. With rear-wheel drive and a five-speed manual transmission, the XR4 offered an engaging driving experience that made it popular among enthusiasts.

The Sierra's distinctive wedge shape and flush-glazed windows were revolutionary for the era, earning it the nickname 'La Sapito' (The Little Toad) in Argentina due to its low, wide stance. This version represents the quintessential 1980s Argentine performance sedan - practical, stylish, and fun to drive.
